product_summary: Official site (shieldlubricants.com, Home + About us, accessed via http_get) lists a full lubricants catalogue: automotive engine oils (Fleet Power Premium/Platinum/Turbo/Max/Synergy/Gold/Ultra/Multi 15W40-20W40, Motor Power, Shield Motor Energy 20W50, CNG Power), 2T/4T two-wheeler oils (Performance Drive/Formula 4T), gear oils (Pro Gear GL-4/GL-5, Pro-ATF, Pro-UTTO, Pro Drive Transmission C4), automotive greases (AP-3, Endura-3, Endura Li-C EP2, GP-3 calcium, WB grease), radiator coolant (Pro Cool), pump set oil (PSO Plus), industrial hydraulic oils (Hydraulic AW 32/46/68/100, Warrior HLP/HLP-N), turbine oils, refrigeration oil 68, air compressor oils ISO 68/220, neat cutting oils (M-Cut Medium/Super/Heavy, Hone Ultra), lubricating oils MFL 68-460, spindle oils, waylube 68/220, knitting oils (Knitt WW/NW), industrial gear oils (Sestina Gear EP 68-460, Xtreme Load 680), quenching oils (Hard Quench FQ/SQ), thermic oil (Thermo Premium 500), shocker/damper oil, soluble cutting oil (Shield Ultra Cut), rust preventive oils (Rustic DW 01, OB 30, OB 100), rubber process oils (Rubber P 30, P 150, A 700), industrial greases (Endura EP-0/00/000, Endura HT Molly, Endura CSC calcium sulphonate complex).
comment: HS 271019 is broadly correct for the core line (petroleum-based lubricating oils and greases) but only PARTIAL: the catalogue contains several lines that fall outside 271019 — radiator coolant/anti-freeze (3820 00), soluble/water-mix cutting oil and water-washable knitting oil (3403 19 / 3402 90), and greases formulated as preparations rather than straight petroleum oils (3403 19). Per project rule 3 the company is NOT rejected for the HS mismatch; the code is corrected/expanded to the actual range and the verdict is accepted_hs_corrected. Industry claim 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is imprecise: this is a lubricant blender/marketer (petroleum downstream, chemical preparations), not an upstream oil & gas or bulk petrochemical supplier — industry should be read as 'lubricants & specialty fluids'. Role: the site self-describes as 'an independent lubricants manufacturer and marketer' with a blending facility in Mumbai (head office: Shelton Sapphire, 806-B, Sector 15, CBD Belapur, Navi Mumbai 400614) — manufacturer, with marketer/own-brand distribution activity; no trader-only signs found, but the blending plant address is not published on the pages read, so own manufacturing is заявлено, не подтверждено. All product lines above are taken from the company's own website catalogue only — no customs line, B/L or GST record was checked in this task, therefore every product/HS mapping is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
